description.en: Appearance skins for the DeepSeek Harness web client: eight industrial-style presets plus colour, font, and background controls. Offline, persistent, and upgrade-safe.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端外观皮肤：八套工业风预设，加上主色 / 字体 / 背景独立定制。离线可用、设置持久化、宿主升级不破版。

description.en: Eight industrial-style skins for the DSH web UI, with brand / accent / neutral / text colours, Chinese and English fonts, and a background image. Settings persist locally; no web fonts.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web UI 的八套工业风皮肤，支持主色 / 辅助色 / 中性色 / 字体色、中英文字体、背景图。设置存在本地，刷新后仍在；不加载任何网络字体。
